idea.title: Why we're building AI for real estate agents in Ghana
idea.angle: Origin story from Kortexa's first carousel: the problem isn't finding leads, it's losing them
idea.hook: The biggest problem in real estate isn't finding leads. It's losing them.

slides.heading: The problem isn't finding leads. It's **losing them.**
Good agents, **too many chats**
slides.body: A buyer asks for property details. You're busy. You forget to follow up. The opportunity disappears. Not because you're bad at sales. Because you can't be everywhere at once.

slides.heading: The same leaks, **again and again**
bullets: Slow replies, so interested buyers go cold
Ad money spent on leads nobody answers in time

slides.heading: Every missed message is a **missed commission.**
AI isn't smart **on its own**
slides.body: A plug-and-play chatbot guesses. What works is the system around it: your listings, your FAQs and clear rules for when a human takes over.

slides.heading: A system that:
bullets: Follows up when buyers go quiet
Hands over to you when it matters

slides.heading: We're **early**, and honest about it
slides.body: We're a small team, talking to agents and building as we learn. No made-up results here. We'll share what works and what doesn't.

slides.heading: Follow along as we **build it**
slides.body: Follow @kortexa and DM 'SYSTEM' for a free trial

caption:
The biggest problem in real estate isn't finding leads. It's losing them.

Agents in Accra, Kumasi and Lagos keep telling us the same thing.
The buyer asks for details. You're on a viewing. The chat goes cold.
Viewings never get booked because nobody followed up.
Ad money goes to leads nobody answered in time.

That's why we're building this, and why we're doing it in public.
